survival.limits: Offers and blocks are repeated samples; starts are activities, work/burn/ready are unique batch phases. Consumed preserved food is actual ledger consumption, not production or possession.

carcass.limits: Repeated opportunities are samples, not independent events. Butchery ticks distinguish paid work from travel. Parts created are finite origins, not recovered outputs.

gear.limits: Samples are not independent opportunities. Direct catch meals count only an observed pack meal while all carried fish came from net collection; mixing and onward transfers lose attribution. The last unobserved tick may be omitted.

livestock.limits: Samples are repeated opportunities. Founders are initial physical animals, not keeper acquisitions. Protection counts only equipped wool actually in use.

nourishment.limits: Actual paid intake and reserve debits; occupancy is start-of-tick. Stories are capped. Health recovery consumes reserves but does not add food. No survival attribution from these counters alone.

timeBudget.method: Start-of-tick living-person occupancy; exclusive categories, actual endings, sampled batch-step opportunities. Critical exposure uses fixed bodily thresholds, not anticipatory thirst. Failure recovery is idle within 80 ticks of failure/interruption. Aborted travel may have achieved partial useful work; it is not automatically wasted time. Open work spells are right-censored.
